title: Independent Coupling Head-Accuracy Objective and Versioned Numerical Policy Template Qualification Closeout
reason: Independent source review supports strict separation of solver convergence, interface coupling convergence, temporal indicator magnitude, application prediction accuracy and physical/model uncertainty, but provides no transferable absolute head-accuracy requirement for the preregistered general SWAP-MODFLOW application class.

downstream.future_release_condition: A narrower application class supplies an independently justified H_app and an independently justified allocation A_temporal before any target fixture is inspected.

hard_nonclaims: no MODFLOW solver tolerance reused as application accuracy
